name: Spiritual Food
overview: Spiritual food, as presented in Scripture, emphasizes the necessity of God's word and righteousness for true life and sustenance. Jesus teaches that man does not live by physical bread alone, but by every word from God, highlighting the vital nourishment found in divine truth (Matthew 4:4). The hunger and thirst for righteousness are met with blessing and fulfillment (Matthew 5:6), and seeking God's kingdom and righteousness ensures provision beyond physical needs (Matthew 6:33). The bread from heaven, symbolizing Christ, offers life that conquers death (John 6:50), while the call to bring tithes into God's storehouse ensures that there is spiritual provision in His house (Malachi 3:10).
